name: iron boots
_design_note: F20-60 medium feet slot. Sabatons with articulated toe plate. Trades movement softness for ankle protection.
lore_template: {material_name} sabatons with articulated toe plates and a riveted ankle guard. Heavy underfoot — underground creatures who try to attack the feet find the experience as productive as attacking a stone floor, though the weight makes running feel like wading through mud.
